activities.instructions: Desliza a la derecha si la frase es correcta y a la izquierda si no lo es.
activities.prompt: Mazo de 6 afirmaciones para repasar el tema.

cards.statement: If the system would be more reliable, we could have avoided yesterday's delay.
cards.explanation: Tras «if» usamos pasado hipotético «were», no «would be».

cards.statement: We wouldn't be lost now if we'd checked the route before leaving.
cards.explanation: La comprobación pasada habría evitado el estado presente de estar perdidos.

cards.statement: If I had gone to bed earlier, I wouldn't be so tired now.
cards.explanation: Es correcta: una acción pasada irreal explica un estado presente.

cards.statement: If the system were more reliable, we could have avoided yesterday's delay.
cards.explanation: Una cualidad presente general del sistema explica una consecuencia pasada.

cards.statement: She would be in Canada now if she had accepted the scholarship.
cards.explanation: La aceptación pasada no ocurrida se relaciona correctamente con una ubicación presente.

cards.statement: If the parts had arrived on time, we might be ready to launch now.
cards.explanation: La llegada pasada habría producido una posible preparación presente.

activities.explanation: Cada carta repasa una regla del tema; revisa las falladas al terminar el mazo.

activities.instructions: Desliza a la derecha si la frase es correcta y a la izquierda si no lo es.
activities.prompt: Mazo de 7 afirmaciones para repasar el tema.

cards.statement: If we'd charged the battery, the phone wouldn't be dead now.
cards.explanation: La carga pasada habría evitado el estado presente de batería agotada.

cards.statement: If Leo would be more patient, he wouldn't have sent that angry reply yesterday.
cards.explanation: El estado presente hipotético usa «were», no «would be», tras «if».

cards.statement: If the roof had been maintained, this room wouldn't be damp today.
cards.explanation: El mantenimiento pasado no realizado explica la humedad presente.

cards.statement: If I would have gone to bed earlier, I wouldn't be so tired now.
cards.explanation: La condición pasada debe ser «if I had gone», no «would have gone».

cards.statement: If we'd charged the battery, the phone wouldn't have dead now.
cards.explanation: El estado presente necesita «wouldn't be dead», no «wouldn't have dead».

cards.statement: If she had spoken German, she could apply for the post last year.
cards.explanation: El marcador «last year» exige un resultado pasado: «could have applied».

cards.statement: If Leo were more patient, he wouldn't have sent that angry reply yesterday.
cards.explanation: Es correcta: un rasgo presente hipotético explica una acción pasada.

activities.explanation: Cada carta repasa una regla del tema; revisa las falladas al terminar el mazo.

activities.instructions: Desliza a la derecha si la frase es correcta y a la izquierda si no lo es.
activities.prompt: Mazo de 8 afirmaciones para repasar el tema.

cards.statement: If they had invested earlier, the company might be profitable now.
cards.explanation: La inversión pasada se conecta con una posible rentabilidad presente.

cards.statement: If they invested earlier, the company might have been profitable now.
cards.explanation: Para causa pasada y efecto presente debe ser «had invested» y «might be profitable now».

cards.statement: If the analyst were more cautious, she wouldn't have published the claim last week.
cards.explanation: Un rasgo presente explica una publicación pasada; la combinación es válida.

cards.statement: She would have still worked here now if she didn't move abroad in 2022.
cards.explanation: La forma precisa es «would still work here now if she hadn't moved abroad».

cards.statement: If they had maintained the database, the service would be stable today.
cards.explanation: El mantenimiento pasado se conecta correctamente con la estabilidad presente.

cards.statement: If I hadn't been so impatient, I wouldn't interrupt her earlier.
cards.explanation: «Earlier» sitúa el resultado en el pasado; debe ser «wouldn't have interrupted».

cards.statement: I would have lived abroad now if I had accepted that scholarship.
cards.explanation: Para un resultado presente usamos «would live» o «would be living», no «would have lived».

cards.statement: I would have a different career now if I had studied engineering.
cards.explanation: Estudiar pertenece al pasado y la carrera imaginada pertenece al presente.

activities.explanation: Cada carta repasa una regla del tema; revisa las falladas al terminar el mazo.
